package fixture

import (
	"testing"

	quicktest "github.com/frankban/quicktest"
)

// Under this alias the identifier `qt` never appears. A rule keyed on that
// spelling went quiet across the whole file; keyed on the import instead, R1 and
// R2 follow the rename and still report both violations. R0 stays because the
// alias is prohibited in its own right: every example in AGENTS.md is written in
// `qt`, and importas refuses any other spelling.
func TestRenamedAlias(t *testing.T) {
	c := quicktest.New(t)
	quicktest.Assert(t, 1, quicktest.Equals, 1)
	c.Run("sub", func(c *quicktest.C) {
		c.Assert(2, quicktest.Equals, 2)
	})
}
